subject: Observability add-ons: retention, tracing & dashboards — pricing and commitment
messages:
From: Jack Santiago <jack.santiago@helios.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Helios is evaluating Redwood for core model serving, and we need to firm up pricing for the observability add-ons (retention for traces, advanced dashboards, and higher-fidelity tracing ingestion).

Two specific asks:
- Retention tiers: we need 30/90/365-day options for traces and dashboard event storage. Please include per-GB/month pricing and any fixed monthly minimums.
- Tracing ingestion: what's the unit pricing at 10M spans/day vs 50M spans/day?

We’re preparing a cost model to share with procurement — can you send a formal pricing sheet and indicate whether Redwood offers volume discounts or committed-spend discounts for these add-ons? Also let us know typical implementation/onboarding credits for storage-heavy customers.

If useful, looping in Priya (procurement) on follow-up. Looking to close by end of month if numbers align.

Thanks,
Jack
VP Product Operations
Helios Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jack Santiago <jack.santiago@helios.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Jack — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a starter pricing spreadsheet (redwood-observability-pricing-v1.xlsx) that lays out our recommended tiers and discount bands. High level:

- Retention tiers (traces / dashboard events):
  • 30d: $0.10 / GB / month
  • 90d: $0.07 / GB / month
  • 365d: $0.045 / GB / month
  (no fixed minimum, but discounts kick in with committed storage spend)
- Tracing ingestion (spans/day):
  • up to 10M spans/day: $0.020 per 1k spans
  • 10M–50M spans/day: $0.015 per 1k spans
  • 50M+: contact for custom pricing
- Advanced dashboards: $6 / editor seat / month; viewers included in platform license

Discount guidance (standard):
- 10% off add-ons for committed spend >= $250k ARR (add-ons only)
- 20% off add-ons for committed spend >= $500k ARR
- Bundled discounts if committing to Dedicated capacity (ask Ben for blended quote)

We can do a one-time onboarding credit for storage migration (typical range $5k–$20k depending on scope) — Marissa (cc) will look at whether we can make that a line item for Helios.

Can we set a 30-min call tomorrow PST to walk numbers and get your expected daily spans / average event payload size? That’ll let us give a firm proposal and an example 12-month TCO.

Best,

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-observability-pricing-v1.xlsx (xlsx spreadsheet summary)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jack Santiago <jack.santiago@helios.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Jack — following up from Soojin’s note. Quick proposal we can tailor:

Option A — Pilot (6 months)- 30d retention for traces + 2 editor seats for dashboards- Tracing ingestion capped at 10M spans/day- Price (add-ons): $6k / month

Option B — Production (12 months)- 90d retention for traces + 6 editor seats- Tracing ingestion at 25M avg spans/day- Price (add-ons): $28k / month (pre-discount)

Attached is a pricing scenarios workbook showing blended unit math for 10/25/50M spans/day (pricing-scenarios-helio.xlsx). If you can share a rough monthly GB for dashboard events and expected avg spans/day we’ll plug in exact numbers and show the committed-spend thresholds met for discounts.

Also, if Helios is willing to commit to a 12-month add-on spend, we can go to ~20% off as standard for your tier; any higher discount will need Marissa’s approval (cc’d).

Thanks — let me know a time to sync.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing-scenarios-helio.xlsx
From: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@helios.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jack Santiago <jack.santiago@helios.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Hi team — thanks for the options. A bit more context from procurement:
- Helios expects ~18–22M spans/day initially, trending to ~40M in 6–9 months.
- Dashboard events are likely ~4TB/month if we enable full instrumentation.
- Procurement target: a 30% first-year discount on add-ons (we can commit to a 12-month term).

We understand standard bands but 30% is important to hit internal ROI at current ARR targets. Also need clarity on data egress costs (if any) and whether archival beyond 365d is supported and at what cost.

Appreciate quick confirmation so we can present to finance this week.

Thanks,
Priya (procurement)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@helios.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Priya / Jack — we appreciate the clarity on volume trajectory. I reviewed the ask and approved the following concession for Helios, conditional on a 12-month committed add-on spend (deal HL-2026-42):

- 20% discount off add-on list prices for year 1 (applies to retention, tracing ingestion, dashboards).
- One-time onboarding credit: $15,000 to support migration and instrumentation tuning.
- Archival beyond 365d: available as cold storage at $0.012 / GB / month (note: retrieval costs may apply).

I can approve up to 20% as an authorized concession. For a 30% discount we’d need a strategic executive exception tied to broader Dedicated capacity commitment; if Helios is open to a blended Dedicated + add-ons commit we can revisit the band.

Attached: SOW_Helios_v2.pdf (updated SOW reflecting onboarding credit). Once Ben confirms numbers in the pricing scenarios we’ll prepare a DocuSign for signature.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales (Enterprise Accounts)
Marissa.Cole@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW_Helios_v2.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jack Santiago <jack.santiago@helios.ai>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@helios.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Final offer & next steps — Helios observability add-ons

Jack / Priya — summarizing the agreed commercial terms and next steps so there’s a single source of truth: 

1) Pricing (year 1)- Retention 90d plan for traces and dashboard events: $0.07 / GB / month (post 20% discount)
- Tracing ingestion at expected 18–22M spans/day: blended unit cost ~$0.012 / 1k spans (after discount)
- Advanced dashboards: $4.80 / editor seat / month (after discount)

2) Credits & archival- Onboarding credit: $15,000 applied to first invoice
- Archival >365d: cold storage at $0.012 / GB / month (as Marissa noted)

3) Conditions- 12-month committed add-on spend (signed SOW HL-2026-42) required for discount to apply

4) Next steps- Ben will provide a final pricing workbook and line items (by tomorrow).
- Marissa will issue the SOW for signature (attached SOW_Helios_v2.pdf).
- DocuSign link to follow; please confirm the primary signatory.

If these terms look good I’ll queue a DocuSign and set a kickoff for the migration team. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HL-2026-42.

Thanks everyone — excited to get Helios onboarded.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-observability-pricing-v1.xlsx, pricing-scenarios-helio.xlsx, SOW_Helios_v2.pdf
